merging.readOnly: You can see these settings. A maintainer changes them.

rules.title: Approval rules
rules.explain: A rule asks for approvals from chosen people or groups before a merge into its target branches.
rules.name: Name
rules.nameHelp: Lower-case letters, digits, "_", "." and "-". It cannot be renamed later.
rules.nameInvalid: Use lower-case letters, digits, "_", "." and "-" (64 at most), starting with a letter or digit.
rules.targetHelp: A pattern such as refs/heads/main or refs/heads/release/*. Empty: every target branch.
rules.targetInvalid: Start with refs/heads/ and use at most one *, only in the last part.
rules.anyoneHelp: With no user, group or organisation condition, anyone who may approve counts.
rules.namesMissing: Some approvers of this rule could not be shown by name, so saving here would remove them and is not offered. Reload the page later, or change the rule with gstn approval-rule.
rules.deleteBody: Merges will no longer wait for the approvals of {{name}}.
rules.nameTaken: A rule with this name exists. Change that rule in the list, or choose another name.

conditions.title: Merge conditions of protected branches
conditions.explain: What a merge into a protected branch needs. When several rules match a branch, the strictest of each applies.
conditions.none: No branch is protected. Protect a branch above to give it merge conditions.
conditions.workItem: A linked work item (PBI) is needed
conditions.workItemUnbound: This project is not connected to Kanflow, so no merge request can link a work item and every merge into this branch is blocked. Ask a maintainer to connect the project, or turn this condition off.
conditions.workItemDialog: Every merge into this branch needs a linked PBI. On a project not connected to Kanflow, nothing can link one, so every merge stops.
conditions.unreportable: No reporter can send some of the required checks, so every merge into this branch is blocked. Ask an administrator to let a service account report them, or remove those checks.
conditions.frozen: Direct pushes are forbidden too, so this branch cannot change at all.
conditions.countHelp: 0 to 20. The protected branch's own minimum.
conditions.checksHelp: Each starts with ci/, kanflow/ or forge/. 20 at most.
conditions.checksInvalid: Each check name starts with ci/, kanflow/ or forge/ and has no spaces (20 names at most).
conditions.saved: The merge conditions of {{pattern}} were saved.
conditions.removeBody: Merges into {{pattern}} will need only what the other rules ask for.
conditions.removed: The merge conditions of {{pattern}} were removed.

autofix.title: Autofix
autofix.intro: When a merge request's pipeline fails or it conflicts with its target, GitStation can run the fixers registered under autofix.fixers in the target branch's .forge-ci.yml (format, lint --fix, lock file regeneration) and add the result as a commit by the autofix bot.
autofix.scope: The bot only changes the paths a fixer lists, never protected branches. Migrations, binary files and protected paths are only proposed. Its commit removes every approval.
autofix.turnedOn: Autofix is on. You are the person whose role the bot's commits are checked with.
autofix.maintainerOnly: Only a Maintainer (or higher) can turn autofix on or off.

autoMerge.title: Auto-merge
autoMerge.intro: When a merge request can be merged, GitStation's auto-merge adds it to the merge queue and merges it when the queue's test is green. Approvals and protected branch rules still apply.

mode.reserve: Reserve only (a person presses "Merge when ready")
mode.conditional: Conditional (changes to authentication, migrations or configuration wait for a person)
mode.full: Fully automatic (the default of new projects)

autoMerge.stopsOnly: Auto-merge stops only when a change may break the program, destroy database data, leak a secret or change code that runs on developers' PCs, and during an emergency stop. A warning does not stop it.
autoMerge.ownerOnly: Only the project's Owner can change the mode (signed in on the web).
autoMerge.stopped: Auto-merge is stopped. Queued auto-merge requests wait. People can still merge.
autoMerge.projectStopped: Auto-merge of this project is under an emergency stop (since {{at}}).
autoMerge.instanceStopped: An administrator stopped auto-merge for everyone (since {{at}}).
autoMerge.fullNotAllowed: An administrator does not allow full auto-merge on this server. Projects set to "Fully automatic" are merged by people.

aiAssets.title: AI assets
aiAssets.intro: Turn this on only when this repository holds the PFS central AI's assets (skills, playbooks, models, evaluation cases). Then the asset lint, the rule that stops auto-merge when an evaluation case holds raw data, the rule that shows an asset change on the merge request as "AI asset change", and asset releases apply to this project. No other project changes.
aiAssets.on: AI asset checks and rules: on
aiAssets.off: AI asset checks and rules: off (default)
aiAssets.turnedOn: AI asset checks and rules are on.
aiAssets.turnedOff: AI asset checks and rules are off.
aiAssets.maintainerOnly: Only a Maintainer or above can change this, signed in on the web (never an agent, a bot or a service account).
aiAssets.offKeeps: Turning it off keeps the history, past releases, signatures and deployment records; only the checks, the rules and new releases stop.

llm.title: AI first-pass review
llm.intro: A local AI reads the latest commit of each open merge request and gives a summary and findings as advice. The advice never approves or blocks a merge.
llm.offHelp: The AI reads no merge request and no forge/ai-review check is made.
llm.requiredHelp: Critical and high findings make forge/ai-review fail. It blocks a merge only if a branch rule makes this check required.
llm.maintainerOnly: Only a Maintainer or above can change this, signed in on the web (never an agent, a bot or a service account).
llm.offKeeps: Turning it off keeps the advice, checks and votes made so far.

docLint.title: Document checks during a migration
docLint.intro: Broken references between documents are errors in the forge/doc-lint check. While documents are being moved into GitStation, you can treat them as warnings until a date. After that date they are errors again by themselves.
docLint.inForce: Migrating: broken references are warnings through the end of {{until}} in UTC (until {{local}} your time). After that they are errors again.
docLint.ended: The migration ended on {{until}}: broken references are errors again.
docLint.help: Required. From {{min}} to {{max}} (at most 180 days). A date lasts through the end of that day in UTC: {{day}} ends at {{local}} your time. Dates are the server's (today is {{today}}, UTC).
docLint.required: Enter the last day of the migration.
docLint.cleared: The migration ended: broken references are errors again.
docLint.readOnly: Only a Maintainer (or higher) can change this.

cli.title: Download the CLI (gstn)
cli.explain: gstn lets you use this server from the command line. Pick the one that matches your PC.
cli.none: This server does not distribute gstn. Ask the administrator.
cli.stepPlace: Put the downloaded file in a folder on your PATH (gstn.exe on Windows, gstn on Linux; on Linux make it executable with chmod +x gstn).
cli.stepVerify: Check that the file's SHA-256 matches the table above (Windows: certutil -hashfile gstn.exe SHA256, Linux: sha256sum gstn).
cli.stepLogin: Save a token made with "Create a token" above to a file and sign in with the commands below.

tokens.agentHelp: Marks the token as used by an agent. Some operations are refused to agents.
tokens.daysInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 365.
tokens.explain: Tokens let tools such as gstn act as you. A token can only be created here, in the browser.
tokens.howTo: To use it with gstn, run:
tokens.name: Name
tokens.nameHelp: What it is for, up to 100 characters.
tokens.nameLong: The name is too long (100 characters at most).
tokens.revokeBody: Tools using the token {{name}} stop working at once. This cannot be undone.
tokens.secretWarning: This is the only time the token is shown. Copy it now and keep it safe; it cannot be shown again.
tokens.title: Access tokens
tokens.finishFirst: Finish with the token shown above before creating another.
tokens.leaveBody: The token is shown only once. If you leave now it is lost for good and you must create a new one.

sshKeys.title: SSH keys
sshKeys.explain: With an SSH key you can git clone, fetch and push over SSH. Use a key of your own (Ed25519 or ECDSA).
sshKeys.disabled: SSH is off on this server. Use the HTTPS URL and an access token.
sshKeys.hostKey: On the first connection, check that the host key fingerprint shown is this one:
sshKeys.deleteBody: The key {{title}} will no longer work for git over SSH. This cannot be undone (the same key can be added again).
sshKeys.keyHelp: Paste the contents of ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub (one line, ssh-ed25519 AAAA…). Never paste a private key.
sshKeys.keyInvalid: Paste one Ed25519 or ECDSA public key line (RSA is not accepted).
sshKeys.titleHelp: A name that tells which device the key is on. Empty: the key's comment. Up to 100 characters.
sshKeys.titleLong: The name is too long (up to 100 characters).

sa.none: There are no service accounts yet. Create the first one below.
sa.disableBody: {{name}} stops working at once and all its tokens are revoked. It cannot be enabled again from this screen.
sa.isDisabled: {{name}} is disabled, so no token can be issued. Create a new service account for the same purpose, or ask the operator to enable it.

actAs.leadUnapprove: {{app}} is trying to withdraw your approval of this merge request.

integrations.noAccounts: No active service account without an integration. Create a service account first (Service accounts tab).

integrations.bindingsExplain: Repositories bound to this integration. They are bound and unbound from kanflow.
integrations.noBindings: No repository is bound to this integration.
integrations.projectExplain: The kanflow projects this repository is bound to. Binding is done from kanflow: you confirm it there.
integrations.projectNone: This repository is not bound to a kanflow project. To bind it, start from the kanflow project.
integrations.unbindBody: This repository is unbound from {{name}} for every kanflow project below: all of them are removed together. Kanflow no longer sees its merge requests.

integrations.unbindAgain: Binding it again is done from kanflow.

docs.problems_other: This document has {{count}} problems. Run gstn doc lint to see them.

schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.subtitle: Run a branch’s pipeline at set times. A schedule runs with the rights of whoever saved it and never uses secrets.
schedules.emptyManage: Use “Add schedule” to pick a branch and a time.
schedules.emptyAsk: To create one, ask a Maintainer or above of this project.
schedules.cronHelp: Five fields: minute hour day month weekday. E.g. 0 2 * * * is every day at 2:00, 30 6 * * 1-5 is weekdays at 6:30. At most once every 5 minutes.
schedules.ownerHelp: Changing the branch or the time rule makes you the owner; from then on it runs with your rights. Editing the description or pausing and resuming keeps the owner.

last.created: Its last run started a pipeline.
last.noDefinition: Its last run started nothing: the branch tip has no .forge-ci.yml. Add the file and push.
last.refMissing: Its last run started nothing: branch {{branch}} does not exist. Create it, or choose another branch with “Edit”.

last.refusedAsk: Stopped: the owner may no longer run pipelines. Ask a Maintainer of this project to save it again.
last.failed: Its last run could not create a pipeline. Ask an administrator to look into schedule #{{id}}.
last.busy: Its last run started nothing: the previous pipeline was still running.
last.capped: Its last run started nothing: scheduled pipelines had reached their hourly limit. It runs again at its next time.

editor.subtitle: Editing a file on the branch {{branch}}.
editor.previewEmpty: The Markdown you write appears here, formatted.
editor.pathHelp: The path from the repository root. Missing folders are created.
editor.pathIsFolder: End the path with a file name (for example docs/spec.md).
editor.tooLarge: The content is larger than {{size}}, so it cannot be saved from the editor. Push it with git.
editor.notBranchTitle: Only a branch can be edited
editor.notBranchBody: The content of a tag or a commit cannot change. Choose a branch, then edit.
editor.cannotEditTitle: This file cannot be edited in the editor

editor.cannotEditLarge: The editor takes files up to {{size}}. Change it with git.
editor.leaveBody: If you leave now, your edits are lost.

dialog.title: Save changes
dialog.descriptionHelp: Say why you changed it; reviewers will see it.
dialog.targetBranch: Create a new branch and propose the change (merge request)
dialog.targetBranchHelp: {{branch}} stays as it is. The change lands after review.
dialog.branchSame: Use a name other than the original branch.
dialog.directHelp: The change lands on {{branch}} at once, without review.
dialog.directForbidden: This branch is protected and takes no direct commits.
dialog.directRole: This branch is protected; your role cannot commit to it directly.
dialog.submitBranch: Save and open a merge request
dialog.rulesFailed: The branch rules could not be checked, so you can save to a new branch only.

error.title: The changes could not be saved
error.conflictNext: Your edits are still on the screen. Copy them, load the latest version, and make your change again.
error.conflictBranch: If the branch name is already taken, choose another name and save again.
error.reloadLatest: Load the latest version (discards your edits)
error.secretTitle: The content looks like it contains a secret
error.secretNext: Remove keys, tokens and passwords from the text, then save again. Revoke any secret that may have leaked.
error.rateLimitNext: Wait about a minute, then save again. Your edits are kept.
error.reloadConfirm: Your edits will be discarded. Copy them first, then reload.

saved.mr: Your change was saved and a merge request was opened (branch {{branch}}).
saved.branch: Your change was committed to the new branch {{branch}}.
saved.mrFailed: The merge request could not be opened: {{message}}

line.running: the {{fixer}} fixer is running on this merge request.
line.applied: fixed automatically: the {{fixer}} fixer added commit {{sha}} (approvals start again). Check the new pipeline.
line.proposed: not committed: the fix of {{fixer}} touches {{paths}} (a migration, a binary file or a protected path). Run the fixer yourself and push.
line.refused: the automatic fix was refused: it changed {{paths}} outside what the fixer may change. Nothing was committed. Tell an administrator (request ID {{requestId}}).
line.failed: the {{fixer}} fixer's job failed; nothing changed. Check its log in Pipelines.
line.denied: the autofix bot may not write this branch (a protected branch, or the author's role). Fix it yourself.

why.instance_stopped: an administrator stopped auto-merge for everyone.
why.project_stopped: auto-merge of this project is under an emergency stop.
why.data_loss: stopped: the change may destroy database data ({{detail}}).
why.leak: stopped: the change may leak personal data or a secret ({{detail}}).
why.developer_pc: stopped: the change touches code that runs on developers' PCs (.claude, CLAUDE.md, .mcp.json, submodules) ({{detail}}).
why.breakage_check: stopped: the required check {{detail}} is red.
why.breakage_queue: stopped: this merge request alone was red in the merge queue.
why.breakage_risk: stopped: the change may delete a large part of the code ({{detail}}).
why.not_assessed: stopped: the risk of the change could not be checked (forge/risk).
why.merge_result: stopped: merged together with the merge requests ahead of it in the merge queue, the result may break the program, destroy database data, leak a secret or change code that runs on developers' PCs.
why.full_not_allowed: an administrator does not allow full auto-merge on this server, so it is not merged automatically.
why.doc_lint_unassessed: stopped: the document check (forge/doc-lint) never reported (or could not run).
why.protected_path: waiting: it touches paths a person decides (authentication, migrations, configuration).
why.conflict: waiting: it conflicts with the target branch.
why.held: a person took it out of the merge queue, so this version is not merged automatically.
why.queued: in the merge queue; it merges when the test is green.
why.queued_warning: in the merge queue with a warning; it merges when the test is green.
why.queued_ai_asset: in the merge queue with a warning: it changes AI assets. It merges when the test is green.
why.queued_by_person: a person put it in the merge queue.
why.queue_doc_lint: stopped: in the merge queue, the documents of the combined result have a new problem, such as a broken reference (forge/doc-lint).
why.queue_doc_base: the documents of the target branch already have problems, so nothing is merged until they are fixed (not caused by this change).
why.queue_doc_unavailable: stopped: the document check of the merge queue could not be completed (too many documents, or a time limit).
why.queue_repo_config: the repository's .forge/repo.yml is invalid, so this is not merged automatically (not caused by this change).

next.instance_stopped: People can still merge; an administrator resumes it.
next.project_stopped: People can still merge; a Maintainer resumes it in the project settings.
next.person_decides: Fix the change, or have a person who checked it press "Merge when ready".
next.fix_and_push: Fix it and push; it continues by itself once green.
next.draft: Mark it ready when it is.
next.merge_when_ready: Check it, then press "Merge when ready".
next.rerun_doc_lint: Push a new commit to run the check again; if it is urgent, a person who checked the change can press "Merge when ready".
next.fix_document: Open the forge/doc-lint check, fix the document and push; it continues by itself.
next.after_target_fixed: Once the target branch is fixed, press "Merge when ready".
next.ask_admin: Ask an administrator; after that, press "Merge when ready".
next.fix_repo_config: Fix .forge/repo.yml first, then press "Merge when ready".

mergeQueue.enqueueHint: Once queued, it is merged automatically when the pipeline passes together with the changes ahead of it.

state.queued: Waiting at position {{position}} in the merge queue.
state.testing: Being tested in the merge queue. It is merged if it passes.

reason.checks_failed: the pipeline with only this change failed
reason.conflict: it conflicts with a change ahead of it
reason.stalled: the test did not finish in time
reason.other: it no longer meets the merge conditions
reason.doc_lint_failed: the documents of the combined result have a new problem, such as a broken reference
reason.doc_lint_base_not_clean: the documents of the target branch already have problems; not caused by this change
reason.doc_lint_unavailable: the document check could not be completed
reason.doc_lint_repo_config_invalid: the repository's .forge/repo.yml is invalid; not caused by this change

next.fix: Fix it, then add it again.
next.doc_lint_failed: Open the forge/doc-lint check, fix the document, then add it again.
next.doc_lint_base_not_clean: Nothing lands until they are fixed; add it again after that.
next.doc_lint_unavailable: Ask an administrator (too many documents, or a time limit).
next.doc_lint_repo_config_invalid: Fix that file first, then add it again.

mergeQueue.title: Merge queue ({{target}})
mergeQueue.subtitle: Queued changes are tested together and merged in order once they pass.
mergeQueue.paused: Paused: nothing is tested or merged. Press resume to continue.
mergeQueue.running: Running: up to {{limit}} changes are tested together.
mergeQueue.emptyHint: Press "Add to merge queue" on a merge request to queue it here.
mergeQueue.mergeWhenReadyHint: This target requires the pipeline on the current target. The merge queue tests the change on it and merges it when it passes.

revert.label: Revert
revert.hint: Opens a merge request that undoes this merge. The target branch does not change until that merge request is merged.

org.title: Organisation

aiEval.title: AI evaluation (compared with the approved baseline)
aiEval.running: The AI evaluation is running. The comparison with the baseline appears here when it ends.
aiEval.unreadable: The evaluation result could not be read as a table, so it is shown as received.
aiEval.seeBelow: The comparison with the baseline is under “AI evaluation” below
aiEval.errorLine: The AI evaluation could not be compared with the baseline, so the merge is stopped ({{code}}). Next:

errorNext.noReport: open the pipeline, check that the evaluation job ran to the end and left eval-report.json, then run the pipeline again.
errorNext.noBaseline: add the baseline to compare with (the file under evals/baselines/) in a separate merge request first.
errorNext.malformed: open the evaluation job’s log and fix how eval-report.json is written.
errorNext.other: open the pipeline and check the evaluation job’s log.

aiEval.passedLine: The AI evaluation is not worse than the baseline. This item does not stop the merge.
aiEval.failedLine_one: The AI’s answers are worse than the baseline in {{count}} point, so the merge is stopped. Next: fix that case and push a new version.
aiEval.failedLine_other: The AI’s answers are worse than the baseline in {{count}} points, so the merge is stopped. Next: fix those cases and push a new version.
aiEval.overview: Model {{models}} · {{total}} cases ({{safety}} safety, {{reproduction}} reproducing a miss).
aiEval.flakyNote_one: {{count}} case whose answer changed from run to run is not counted.
aiEval.flakyNote_other: {{count}} cases whose answers changed from run to run are not counted.
aiEval.findingsCut: Only some reasons are shown. All of them are in the evaluation job’s eval-report.json.
aiEval.more_one: {{count}} more case (all cases are in eval-report.json).
aiEval.more_other: {{count}} more cases (all cases are in eval-report.json).

reason.safetyFailed: Safety case {{subject}} did not pass every run (a safety case must pass every time).
reason.safetyMissing: Safety case {{subject}} is not in this evaluation.
reason.safetyRunsShort: Safety case {{subject}} ran fewer times than in the baseline.
reason.reproductionNotFixed: Case {{subject}}, which reproduces a miss, is not fixed yet (it must pass more than half of the runs).
reason.caseNotReproducing: Case {{subject}} should reproduce a miss but already passes in the baseline. Review the case.
reason.stableRegressed: Case {{subject}} passed every run in the baseline and now fails at least half of the runs.
reason.caseMissing: Case {{subject}} passed every run in the baseline and is not in this evaluation.
reason.caseKindChanged: The kind of case {{subject}} differs from the baseline.
reason.metricPastDelta: The measure “{{subject}}” is worse than the baseline by more than the allowed difference.

aiEval.unreadableCut: It is long, so only the beginning is shown. All of it is in the pipeline’s evaluation job.

approve.lead: Approving is your own action on this screen. Pressing it reads the facts again before asking.
approve.changed: The facts or the status changed after they were shown. Check the lists above, then press Approve again.
approve.warnFrozen: A freeze window is in force now.
approve.warnRange: The range of changes could not be read (the lists of changes are unknown).

market.title: Marketplace
market.subtitle: Find signed agent parts (skills, hooks, rules and more) to build a project's agent configuration.
market.emptyHint: Set the kind and channel back to All, or search for another name.
market.deprecated: This part is deprecated: do not start using it.

publish.title: Publish a part
publish.explain: Publishes the tag <part>/v<version> of the parts repository. Its commit must be on the default branch with its newest pipeline succeeded. Whoever pushed, tagged or wrote it cannot publish it.
publish.slugInvalid: A part's name is lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, at most 64.
publish.newPart: A new part (no version published yet).
publish.currentCaps: Capabilities of the current newest version {{version}}
publish.after: A published version starts on beta; after three days another Maintainer moves it to stable.
publish.next: If a capability was added, check it again before moving the version to stable.

part.allRevoked: Every version of this part is revoked. Projects using it should update.
part.verifyHint: Check the signature and digest locally with gstn agent verify.
part.networkAdminOnly: Only an administrator can make a part that uses the network stable.
part.revokeExplain: Revoking is final. Projects using this version fail forge/agent-lock until they update.
part.reasonLong: The reason is at most 500 characters.

agentBuilder.title: Agent
agentBuilder.subtitle: Build this project's Claude Code configuration (.claude/, CLAUDE.md, .mcp.json) from signed parts.
agentBuilder.settingsIntro: Build the Claude Code configuration from signed marketplace parts as a merge request.
agentBuilder.reporterOnly: Reporters and above can see the agent settings.
agentBuilder.developerOnly: Developers and above choose parts and create the merge request.
agentBuilder.unavailable: Parts without a stable version to pick: {{slugs}}

update.title: Updates available
update.next: The choice below has the new versions. Press "See the Dry-Run diff", check it, then press "Create the merge request".
update.nextReader: A Developer or above can create the update's merge request.

agentBuilder.noAdapter: No adapter to use yet: one must be published on stable in the marketplace first.
agentBuilder.previewFirst: See the diff before creating the merge request (nothing is written).
agentBuilder.noChanges: Nothing changes against {{branch}}: no merge request is needed.
agentBuilder.widens: {{slug}} widens the permission settings: check it in the merge request's review.
agentBuilder.compileHint: The merge request waits for a Maintainer's approval (never merged automatically).
agentBuilder.committedOnly: Committed on {{branch}}, but the merge request was not opened.
agentBuilder.noHistory: No builds yet: choose the parts above and start with the Dry-Run.

aiAdvice.title: AI review (first pass)
aiAdvice.label: AI advice (suggestion)
aiAdvice.none: There is no AI advice now.
aiAdvice.running: The AI is reviewing the latest commit. This section updates by itself when it is done.
aiAdvice.failed: The AI first pass failed for the latest commit; it is not a pass. Have a person check the change.
aiAdvice.withheld: Not shown: the input is confidential.
aiAdvice.stale: This advice is out of date: it was made for commit {{sha}}, not the latest commit {{head}}.
aiAdvice.degraded: Less trustworthy advice (a verdict was withheld or findings without evidence were dropped). Check the change itself.
aiAdvice.deepTitle: A deeper review (Claude or a person) is recommended
aiAdvice.adviceOnly: This is advice. It never approves or blocks a merge: tests, required checks and people decide.
aiAdvice.rerunHint: Asks the AI to review the latest commit again (at most 3 times an hour per merge request).
aiAdvice.rerunPending: This commit is already waiting for its review.
